component.name: Indeks
component.summary: Find, organize and annotate documents wherever they are stored

description.p: Indeks keeps track of your documents without taking them away from where they are. It indexes folders on this computer, on external drives and on servers, and makes their files findable by name, by the text inside them and by the text recognized in images and scans.

ul.li: Search file names, document text, notes and text recognized by OCR, with filters for tags, groups, types, dates and more
An inbox for documents that still need to be filed, plus groups, tags, saved searches and rules to keep order
Previews for plain and formatted text, PDF documents, images, exported e-mails and Obsidian canvases
Notes on every document and freehand drawing on images and PDF pages
Originals are never modified: editing and drawing happen on a copy kept by Indeks
Documents on unplugged drives and unreachable servers stay searchable
Every function is available from the command bar with Ctrl+Alt+I
“Send to Indeks” for folders in the context menu of the Dolphin file manager

description.p: Documents can be linked to one another.

ul.li: “Manage Linked Documents…” (Ctrl+L), in the context menu and in the Information tab, shows the documents a document is linked to and finds others to link
“Link Selected Documents” links several documents with one another at once
The search term is:linked finds the documents that have links
In a rule, filter choices that no document matches yet can be chosen, so a rule can be kept to the inbox while the inbox is empty
Opening a database with this version brings it up to date; version 0.2.0 and older cannot open it afterwards

description.p: Files now come into Indeks through indexed folders only, and databases are chosen with more care.

ul.li: A new installation asks whether to start a new database or to open one that exists
“Add Database…” opens a database by its file index.sqlite; “New Database…” starts one and warns when the folder is not empty
Indeks marks its index files as its own and leaves a file of that name from another program untouched
Single files can no longer be added: “Add Files…” is gone, and “Send to Indeks” in Dolphin is for folders

description.p: The first release: indexing in place, search, groups, tags and rules, previews of many kinds of documents, notes and drawing, a to-do list, scripts, and a manual.
